nodes.description: A patent publication titled "Methods and apparatus of context-data acquisition and ranking" that discloses a system, method, and article of manufacture for acquiring and ranking context data based on a query derived from a short message.

A method of determining a context-data type from a query, identifying context-data sources providing that type, generating requests for context data, and ranking received context data according to a specified parameter.
A classification of context data determined algorithmically from the meaning of a term of a short message, providing information about the environment or context of the mobile device.
A provider that supplies context data of a particular context-data type, which can be identified, ranked, and requested from by the system.

A message content whose meaning the context-data is related to, and to which relevant context data is linked and formatted according to a communication protocol.<SEP>A message received from a mobile device whose terms are analyzed to determine a context-data type; context data may be associated with, appended to, encoded into, or forwarded with the short message.
A device such as a smart phone that generates a short message and a query, and to which received context data may be provided.

A computing device associated with the context-data provider that collects the set of context-data.<SEP>A computing system that receives short messages from mobile devices, determines context-data types, identifies and ranks context-data sources, and generates requests for context data.

A criterion used to rank context-data sources, which may include a pecuniary cost to acquire context data, a state of the receiving mobile device, a state of an available communication network, or a cost value of the context data.
A mobile device that receives context data, possibly associated with or appended to a short message, or a URI of a database server.
A storage system available to a recipient mobile device in which received context data may be stored and queried via metadata instructions.
An identifier of a database server that may be forwarded to a receiving mobile device to access stored context data.
A language used to encode received context data into a short message.
An apparatus comprising at least one memory with program instructions and at least one processor configured to execute operations for context-data acquisition and ranking.
A medium comprising computer-executable instructions adapted to perform the context-data acquisition and ranking method.

An entity with at least one server that collects and provides a set of context-data, and is allowed to provide a cost of the context-data.<SEP>A source from which a set of context data related to the meaning of short message content is collected by a server.
A device by which the context-data is obtained.<SEP>A device by which context data is obtained, related to the meaning of short message content.

A measure used to algorithmically select relevant context data, comprising a monetary cost of the context-data.<SEP>A measure used to algorithmically select relevant context data, which may include a monetary cost of the context data.
A type of mobile device that may generate the short message.
A network through which context data is rendered for communication to a mobile device, and whose state may serve as a specified parameter.
Data elements related to the meaning of a short message content, collected from context-data providers and obtained by a physical sensor, weighted and selected according to at least one metric.
The cost of the context-data, used as a metric for selecting relevant context data.
A protocol according to which the relevant context data and the short message are formatted, such as a cellular network short message protocol or an internet communication protocol.
A type of communication protocol used for formatting the relevant context data and the short message.
A type of communication protocol used for formatting the relevant context data and the short message.
A device that generated the short message and has a physical context to which the context data is related.

edges.description: The patent publication US8509827B2 discloses a system, method, and article of manufacture of context-data acquisition and ranking.
The method algorithmically determines a context-data type from the meaning of a term of a short message.
The method identifies at least one context-data source providing the context-data type, ranks it according to a specified parameter, and generates a request for context data from it.
The method receives and analyzes a short message from a mobile device to determine the context-data type.
The method receives a short message from a mobile device and provides received context data to the device that generated the short message.
The method is performed with a server that receives the short message and generates requests for context data.
The method ranks context-data sources according to a specified parameter such as pecuniary cost, device state, or network state.
The method provides received context data to a recipient mobile device.
The method stores received context data in a database available to a recipient mobile device.
The method forwards a Uniform Resource Identifier of a database server to the receiving mobile device.
The method encodes received context data into the short message with a markup language.
The computerized apparatus with memory and processor performs the operations of context-data acquisition and ranking.
A computer readable medium comprises computer-executable instructions adapted to perform the method.
The method collects a set of context data from at least one context-data provider with at least one server.
The method algorithmically selects relevant context data according to a metric comprising a monetary cost.
The context data is obtained by a physical sensor.
The context-data source provides the context-data type.
The context-data source is ranked according to a specified parameter.
The short message and received context data are forwarded to the recipient mobile device.
The context-data is related to the meaning of the short message content, and relevant context data is linked to the short message.
The relevant context data and the short message are formatted according to a communication protocol.
The mobile device that generated the short message may comprise a smart phone.
The context-data provider has at least one server used to collect the set of context-data.<SEP>The set of context data is collected from the context-data provider with at least one server.
The state of an available communication network may serve as a specified parameter.
The database storing received context data is available to the recipient mobile device.
The context-data provider, with at least one server, collects and provides a set of context-data related to the meaning of a short message content.
The context-data provider is allowed to provide a cost of the context-data.
The context-data is obtained by a physical sensor.
The metric comprises a monetary cost of the context-data.
The context-data is weighted and algorithmically selected according to at least one metric.
The context data is related to a physical context of the device that generated the short message.
The communication protocol comprises a cellular network short message protocol.
The communication protocol comprises an internet communication protocol.
